note: Jenkins: the six-part works have an optional organ part in Musica Britannica 39 (Wikipedia table, BnF title) that the entries leave out; Wikipedia swaps the keys of the two In Nomines (MusicBrainz and the recordings agree with the entries). VdGS numbers run per group, so VdGS 5, 7, 8 recur for different scorings; the fantasia-suites' note that the organ part is written out was not verified.
